classification: Retrospective development on previously opened 70 logical clients, not independent validation
design: Fixed before running new model outcomes; all registered arms are reported, including failures
partitions: Reuse exact corrected physical-feature 60/20/20 chronological healthy split; all fault windows test-only. Five unknown clients retain explicitly unverified assumed commissioning, not verified healthy training.
features: Exact 22 physical features and training-only transform from thesis_70_improvement.py; no upstream learned or label-derived prediction features
personalization: Shared encoder, persistent local decoder. This adapts shared-representation learning; it is not an exact replication of a supervised FedRep paper.
svdd: Reconstruction plus distance to fixed training-initialization latent center, entries with magnitude below 0.1 clamped away from zero; not a claim of exact Deep SVDD replication or collapse immunity
synthetic: Fixed seeded generic feature-space perturbations derived only from training healthy/assumed commissioning rows, plus balanced binary head. These are NOT measured faults or physics-validated waveform simulations. No real fault labels used for fitting.
pca: Device-local centered training PCA rank min(4,n-1,22), score residual mean square; non-federated analytical comparator
primary_learning_comparison: All model variants under unchanged local point-0.995 threshold and continuous 3-of-5 alarm logic
calibration_ablation: Cross every model with every fixed calibration mode, never select a threshold using a fault row
block_guard: Non-overlapping groups of five complete rolling 3-of-5 calibration statistics; max(point995, q95 of group maxima plus their MAD sigma). Fewer than four groups: point995 fallback. No lifetime false-alarm guarantee.
anchored_drift: Past-only log-score EWMA alpha0.01, only low-risk non-alarm samples, one calibration-MAD cap, total threshold at most twice initial. Immutable calibration anchor. May still absorb slow faults; report rather than guarantee safety.
strict: No held-out healthy alarm and a fault-period persistent alarm for fault lifecycles; no held-out healthy alarm for controls. State never resets at known onset.
replication_gate: Original global AE seed17070 must match stored corrected model and 24/65,56/59,39/65,1/6 metrics; zero reference must match26/65. Stop on mismatch, do not tune.
advancement_gate: For every seed of a learned-model/calibration pair: strict exceeds both26 and the best analytical/untrained reference under that SAME calibration, faults detected>=56, control alarms<=1. This is a development-screen rule, not a significance or validation claim.
scope: All70 endpoint first; no rewrite of old3571-subset study and no claim this new endpoint is a completed node-scaling campaign. If no candidate passes the advancement gate, report that negative result rather than rerunning the costly full curve.
communications: Float32 model parameters plus16byte application header,200byte application fragment body,12 rounds; report personalized private state separately. Analytical packet screen only, not wire codec or LoRaWAN/RF validation.
stopping: Complete all fixed arms and three seeds; no unbounded parameter search to force90percent
